newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL-Office Depot at lower levels.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL-Office Depot at lower levels.

text.p: Shares in office supply company Office Depot Inc, weighed by the likely end of a merger deal with Staples Inc, traded before Tuesday's market opening roughly where they had fallen in after-hours trading.

Traders said Office Depot was trading actively at 14-1/4, down from a Monday close of 19-7/16. The shares had fallen to 14-1/2 in after-hours trade Monday, hit by a court decision blocking its merger with Staples.
Staples was trading at 24-1/8, up from Monday's close of 23-1/4.

In other active stocks, FORE Systems Inc was trading at 12 after a Monday close of 13-5/8. The computer networking company said early Tuesday it expected first-quarter income to be below that of the same period a year before.
"They are hitting this thing pretty hard right now," a trader said.
Washington Mutual Inc was trading at 61-1/2, up from a Monday close of 59-3/4. A trader said the stock was being boosted by Lehman Brothers' adding it to list of "uncommon value" shares.
The stock's addition to the Standard & Poors 500 index also helped it higher, he said.

Cyrix Corp was at 19-1/2, down from a Monday close of 21-3/8, after the computer chip maker said it expected to post a loss in the second quarter. Intel Corp was at 140-1/2, down from a closing price of 141-52/64.
Westinghouse Electric Corp was trading at 24, up from a Monday close of 23-1/8.
